Practical, hands-on engineering experience.  Opportunity to improve business efficiency and performance.  Involvement in a variety of projects and operations.  Collaborative and supportive team environment.  Opportunity to make a real impact on quality, safety, and productivity    Task & responsibilities   Studying functional statements, organisational charts, and project information to determine functions and responsibilities of workers and work units and to identify areas of duplication.  establishing work measurement programs and analysing work samples to develop standards for labour utilisation. Analysing workforce utilisation, facility layout, operational data and production schedules and costs to determine optimum worker and equipment efficiencies.  Developing specifications for manufacture, and determining materials, equipment, piping, material flows, capacities and layout of plant and systems  Organising and managing project labour and the delivery of materials, plant, and equipment  Establishing standards and policies for installation, modification, quality control, testing, inspection, and maintenance according to engineering principles and safety regulations  Inspecting plant to ensure optimum performance is maintained  Directing the maintenance of plant buildings and equipment, and coordinating the requirements for new designs, surveys, and maintenance schedules  Ensure that safety protocols are rigorously followed, conducting risk assessments, and implementing safety measures to protect workers and the environment  Collaborating with project managers to assist in project planning and execution. Help in resource allocation, project scheduling, and identifying potential risks to meet project deadlines and budgets.    Qualification & experience   Relevant qualification at the level of a bachelor’s degree or higher, OR at least 5 years of relevant work experience, will substitute for formal qualifications.  Strong communication skills  Intermediate-level user of Microsoft Office  Continuous improvement experience and willingness to be hands-on.
